==Steps==
#Go back to Jinzhou and meet up with Chixia
# Solve the puzzle

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|The purposes and directions of the three tokens have all been found. All the answers of the riddles seem to be hidden behind the mysterious gate that the sundial hints at.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;Go back to Jinzhou and meet with Chixia
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_1.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' How did it go? Anyone hurt? Lemme check on you!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_2.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Phew! You're still in one piece.
:{{DIcon}} Course I am. You're overreacting.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_16.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Okay okay. Anything new about the tokens?
:''You tell Chixia of your findings in the Desorock Highlands and Qichi Village.''
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_18.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' So those Fractsidus goons are here in Jinzhou now. Things are more serious than I thought.
:{{DIcon}} I wonder what they are up to.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_20.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Beats me. I've only ran into some bozos before.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_21.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Those wackos are hellbent on making their own Resonators. Said there's no right or wrong when it comes to Resonance powers and everyone should have the right to them.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_22.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' They use mechanical manipulation to integrate parts of Tacet Discords into human bodies.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_52.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Seeking power with such gruesome acts... I cannot bring myself to understand them.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_23.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' That Scar guy you mentioned sounds like he's on a whole other level. How did the fight go?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_24.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' He... It seems he didn't intend to kill us. I would say he was even pulling his punches.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_25.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' I don't know what he wants from us. But Madam Magistrate may have intended to hint something by letting us run into him.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_26.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' I still can't wrap my head around what happened in that village...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_27.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' I went over the files. That case is ancient. It was dealt with and archived way before our current Magistrate took office.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_28.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' What happened to the village in the end?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_29.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Don't worry, the crooks were brought to justice, and most of the villagers were relocated to new settlements.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_30.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' But I didn't find anything in the files about that little girl you mentioned.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_31.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' So Scar really did take her away.
:{{DIcon}} And it seems he did not hurt her.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_55.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' I agree.
:{{DIcon}} Maybe the Fractsidus had plans to use her for something.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_56.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' ...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_57.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' If only we could capture him...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_32.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Ugh... I'm so lost. Why did Madam Magistrate point you to Qichi Village anyway? What did she want to tell you with that?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_58.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' And then Scar went there to tamper with the site and mislead you with fake clues...
:{{DIcon}} Or maybe it's the other way around.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_33.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' You mean...?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_60.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' The Fractsidus was planning to tell you something about what had happened in that village. Then our Magistrate intercepted by leading you there before they could?
:{{DIcon}} Scar wanted to preach his ideas to me.
:{{DIcon}} I suppose she just made use of the occasion.
:{{DIcon}} She knew what was going to happen.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_77.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' ...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_37.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Madam Magistrate knew they were going to lure you to the village. And she knew they weren't planning to kill you.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_38.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Her token was a warning that the Fractsidus had their eyes on you...
:{{DIcon}} Plus, even if Scar really tried to kill us...
:{{DIcon}} We wouldn't be in real danger.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_41.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' How so?
:{{DIcon}} Jinzhou's way of hospitality, remember?
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_62.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' You mean she's got someone looking out for you?
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_63.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Or maybe she prepared other means of protection.
:{{DIcon}} In a game of Weiqi, when the Black moves, White is sure to follow.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_64.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Yes, I agree. Knowing their plans, Madam Magistrate would have prepared countermeasures for the worst scenario.
----<!-- the following is a new dialogue node, hence the separator -->
:{{DIcon}} ...
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_67.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' What's the matter, Rover?
:{{DIcon}} And vice versa. Since the White has made her move...
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_68.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Uh, I don't think I follow.
::{{DIcon}} Nothing in particular.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_70.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' The legendary figure who changed Jinzhou's history, a looming war with the resurrecting Threnodian, and the Fractsidus acting in the shadows...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_71.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' If all of these have something to do with your true identity. Then... who exactly are you?
:{{DIcon}} I'm hoping Madam Magistrate has the answer.
:{{DIcon}} I am your friend, the one you know as Rover.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_46.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Yes... You will always be the Rover we know, no matter what.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_47.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' That same old TD eating, Echo munching Rover all right!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_48.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Come to think of it, the sundial's the last token we need to work out.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_49.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Mr. Mortefi said it's an intricate puzzle box. Madam Magistrate might have hid her real message inside.
:{{DIcon}} We learned about the time at the Academy.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_74.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Yes. It's the 12th {{Rubi|Shichen|Time Period}} of the day, represented by the symbol Wei.
:{{DIcon}} We learned about the direction in Qichi Village.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_75.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Yes. It's the South, represented by the Vermillion Bird, one of the Four Symbols.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_73_51.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Now we have the Shichen of Wei and Vermillion Bird. We should be able to solve the puzzle.

;Solve the sundial puzzle box
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_74_39.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' So, Rover, you're gonna try it now?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_74_40.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Symbols on the larger disk represent time, and we need to align the correct symbol with this pointer. It should be....
:{{DIcon}} The Shichen of Yoh.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_74_43.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' It's not working. So we can rule out the {{Rubi|Shichen|Time Period}} of Yoh now... The correct time we learned at the Academy should be....
:{{DIcon}} The Shichen of Wei.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_74_44.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' It's working. And now...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_74_45.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Symbols on the smaller disk represent direction, and we need to align the correct symbol with this pointer. It should be....
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_74_46.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' We have Teal Loong of the East, White Tiger of the West, Vermilion Bird of the South, and Black Tortoise of the North. According to the clues we've gathered, it should be...
:{{DIcon}} White Tiger of the West.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_74_49.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' It's not working. I guess it's not the White Tiger.
:{{DIcon}} Vermilion Bird of the South.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_74_50.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Wow, you really solved it!
:''(So this is the last message the Magistrate has for me. This is... the location of Jinzhou's Grand Library.)''
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_74_1.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Wait, I don't think it's something we're allowed to see.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_74_2.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Quick, Yangyang. We should turn around!
:{{DIcon}} Why should you?
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_74_6.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' It's gotta be some super confidential stuff Madam Magistrate's written for Rover's eyes only!
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_74_7.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' As public servants... Well, even though we're both just reservists. We know there are rules to follow!
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_74_8.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Chixia has a point.
:{{DIcon}} It's nothing you can't see.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_74_9.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Maybe you should read it first, Rover?
:{{DIcon}} We solved this together.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_74_10.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Come on, just go ahead and see what's written inside!
----<!-- the following is a new dialogue node, hence the separator -->
:{{DIcon}} It's about the Grand Library...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_74_12.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' I see. The Grand Libraries in Huanglong are renowned for their vast databases, holding valuable information about the regions they represent. Their exact locations are kept confidential, but it is believed they hold answers to all questions one could ask.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_74_13.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' The Grand Libraries are vital for Huanglong's data security, managed by the regional Sentinels, accessible only to the Magistrates. They are rarely open to the public.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_74_14.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Kinda like a big piggy bank inside the City Hall. Data-wise!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_74_15.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Yes. You will find the most comprehensive and accurate information there.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_74_16.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Rover, if you'll need to visit the Grand Library in Jinzhou to find out who you are, I think it suggests two things....
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_74_17.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' First, there is a strong link between your past and Jinzhou's history.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_74_18.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Second, you must be a really significant person.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_74_19.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' So you're super important to Jinzhou, maybe even all of Huanglong...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_74_20.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Wow, I think we stumbled upon a real big shot when we didn't even know it!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_74_21.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' What's that matter, Rover? Something wrong with the sundial?
:{{DIcon}} Is the City Hall at the center of Jinzhou?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_74_23.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' It is Jinzhou's political center. And it's also located at the city's center, if that's what you mean.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_74_24.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' The City Hall was built first when Jinzhou was established. It's a popular landmark for locals giving directions.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_74_36.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Why do you ask, Rover?
:{{DIcon}} Nothing in particular.
:{{DIcon}} Madam Magistrate wishes to meet me alone.
:{{DIcon}} I'll need to go somewhere on my own.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_74_27.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' See? What did I say! Covert ops, real confidential stuff going on!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_74_38.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' ...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_74_28.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' C'mon, Yangyang. It's just an one-on-one meeting with Madam Magistrate. What's the worst that could happen?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_74_29.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Relax, relax!
:{{DIcon}} I wouldn't be so sure about that.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_74_32.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Hey! Are you really trying to stress her out?
:{{DIcon}} Indeed.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_74_33.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' I guess you're right. Still, please be careful.
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_56.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' We'll be waiting for you.

:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_5_81_31.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Thanks to their extra help, my meeting with you went smoothly.
